driver: The decisive quantity is the chance that the weakest of a few members taken together from one new group falls below a threshold, when the predictor's error is mostly a group effect the members share and shows only in the outcomes of whole groups followed to the end; compounding each member's marginal chance as if the members were independent overstates the count, and only carrying the group's share of the error into the members' joint chance gives it.
driver_concrete: Every Model K pack takes its three series cells from one formation tray (7,063 of 7,200), and the release model's prediction error is mostly a tray effect (standard deviation 0.160 on the log scale shared by a tray's cells against 0.086 each cell's own, 78 per cent of the variance, visible only in the life tests of the finished lots' whole trays cycled to 80 per cent), so the reserve is the expectation over a new tray's shared error of the chance that any of a pack's three cells falls below 80 per cent of rated capacity within 600 cycles, 400 packs (398.9), where compounding each cell's chance of 2.4 per cent over three independent cells files 500 (514).
stump: A competent solver computes RL-3's features for lot ZC2638's 120 release-test cells, predicts each cell's life with the model's validation error, averages each cell's chance of falling below 80 per cent within 600 cycles (2.4 per cent) and compounds it over a pack's three cells as if they were independent, filing 500 packs (514); the step that lands it there is treating a pack's cells as independent draws when they are tray-mates whose model error is mostly shared, so a pack's chance is the tray-shared joint chance (5.5 per cent) and the reserve 400 (398.9).
analyst_test: A strong analyst who stacks both cycler exports, computes RL-3's features exactly as QM-07 defines them, predicts every release-test cell's life with the model's validation error and counts a pack as failing when its weakest cell does files 500 packs (514) by compounding the cell chance over three independent cells (checking the release test's own predictions for a tray effect finds almost none and files 500 again); only carrying the tray-mates' shared part of the model error, seen in the finished lots' whole-tray life tests, into each pack's joint chance files 400 (398.9).
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the posterior predictive chance that the weakest of three new members of a new group falls below the warranty line, which a hierarchical model of the release model's error gets by integrating the between-tray variance over the members a pack shares; replacing that predictive with the pooled cell-level error compounded independently (the generic summary of the model's accuracy) moves the reserve from 400 to 500 packs, so the call turns on the task type's own object, the predictive for new groups with between-group variance.
